network.failure: overload beyond mitigation capacity or inactive/unavailable scrubbing marks the protected path unavailable until an explicit simulation tick advances the bucket.

sip.failure: unknown/unavailable/unauthenticated peer, method mismatch, malformed or oversized message, or rate overflow is retained with a synthetic reason.

destination.unit: AUD cents from the core's 2-cent-per-queued-or-handling-voice-minute charge
destination.failure: unapproved destination is rejected before call admission; per-call and rolling-window caps are rechecked before each core voice-minute charge. Settlements reconcile against actual core minute rows and their voice interaction IDs; this module issues no money.

reference_fixture.billingContract: The core calls preflight and admit before an outgoing voice call is accepted. Immediately before each active queued/handling interaction contributes to core usage, the core calls admitUsage; a block excludes that interaction before calculating usage. The core writes minute-N ledger rows with usage and voiceInteractions (one unique interaction ID per admitted unit), with voice cost included in row cost at 2 AUD cents per usage unit. On every terminal outcome it calls settle; the module reconciles each admitted minute against those actual core rows and does not post a second charge. Failed calls preserve already incurred usage costs.

completionCriteria: A packet flood is filtered within configured PPS capacity while protected path remains available; unfiltered overflow records a failure.
A valid authenticated INVITE is admitted and at least one invalid, unauthenticated, disallowed-method or over-rate signalling sample is blocked.
A permitted, resolved voice interaction has actual usage reconciled against the core AUD-cent minute ledger; a destination/spend fixture is blocked before any over-limit minute charge accrues.
All three controls are independently effective. Bandwidth, seats, agents and credits are never substituted for PPS, signalling attempts or AUD cents.
